row.title: A shelved or gated item is not a done item (DISPOSE-1 vs checks)
row.body: DISPOSE-1 closes an over-limit item as Status closed, Disposition shelved or gate. Checks that read Status alone (build_site_roadmap pins and gaps, market --check) then treated open gaps as finished and failed main. Any check reading item status must also read Disposition; finished means closed and (not shelved or gate, or its own probe passes). Fixed in scripts/build_site_roadmap.py and foundation/market.py.
